description.en: 提示词库 · Prompt vault for DSH: save reusable prompts as plain Markdown notes (Obsidian-compatible) and insert them from the composer; edit, search-save, soft delete, plus a prompt_vault tool for the model.
description.zh: 把常用提示词存成本机 Markdown 文件，任意会话一键插入复用，Obsidian 也能直接打开。

description.en: Plan usage, account balance and running cost in the DeepSeek Harness composer dock: DeepSeek wallet, OpenCode Go subscription windows, and a per-session cost estimate. Provider-extensible, plain JavaScript, no build step.
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek 余额、订阅用量和本次会话花费，花钱心里有数。

description.en: Remote control for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): pair a phone by QR code and keep working on the computer from the browser.
description.zh: 扫码把手机和电脑配对，就能在手机浏览器里远程操控 DSH，人离开电脑也能接着干活。

description.en: A DSH agent preset that turns one session into a small, coordinated research team.
description.zh: 一个会话就能拉起一支小研究团队，分工协作帮你查资料、做调研。

description.en: 一个为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供独立副模型二次评审的插件，做到两个模型接入一个对话，在主模型回答后自动检查潜在风险与代价，必要时可选择副模型接管任务。
description.zh: 主模型答完副模型自动复核，帮你揪出潜在风险和代价，必要时还能接管任务。

description.en: Session Booth: a persistent multi-session split view in the DSH main window. 在 DSH 主窗口提供持久化的多会话分屏视图。
description.zh: 在主窗口并排查看多个会话，分屏互不干扰，布局自动保存，切换回来还在。

description.en: DSH 会话清理 · DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件：按体积排序会话、归档、删除进可撤销回收站（整批或单条还原）、清理孤立投影缓存与失效归档项。| Sidebar session cleanup panel for DSH: size-sorted sessions, archive, undoable recycle bin, orphan projection-cache cleanup.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏会话清理工具，按体积排序会话，支持归档、可撤销回收站和孤立缓存清理。

description.en: Shione / 汐音 - verbatim-first memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Personal project, still rough, still improving. Created and maintained by AI.
description.zh: 会记住你说过的每一句话，让 AI 助手拥有长期记忆和人格延续。

description.en: DSH 临时消息插件：可执行模板、token/步数生命周期、可扩展上下文压缩器。
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一条会过期的上下文消息通道，按 token 或步数自动刷新，还能跑动态模板。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: five memory kinds, relevance-filtered injection, review inbox, local SQLite store, zero runtime dependencies. Unofficial third-party project.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加上长期记忆，按相关度自动注入，还能在收件箱里回顾整理。

description.en: Use Tokener models in DeepSeek Harness (dsh): install the plugin, connect your API key, and pick a model.

description.en: 🌍 Select text, translate in place. A card under your selection in DeepSeek Harness — your own model first, configurable fallbacks behind it.
description.zh: 选中聊天里的文字，就在下方弹出翻译卡片，优先用你自己的模型，还能配置备用模型。

description.en: DSH 插件：模型正常结束但任务没做完时自动续跑，回复以「完成」收尾才算真完成。
description.zh: 模型说完了但活儿没干完？它自动补一句「继续」催模型接着干，回复以「完成」收尾才算真结束。

description.en: Windows desktop-control plugin for DeepSeek Harness: accessibility refs, SendInput pixel actions, GDI screenshots, browser DOM, clipboard, notifications, in-process waits and an operator pause switch.
description.zh: 让 AI 直接操控 Windows 桌面：读界面、点鼠标、截图、管剪贴板，还能随时暂停。

description.zh: 一键把已安装 DSH 插件的英文界面换成中文，离线词典翻译，开关随时还原

description.zh: 把对话蒸馏成结构化记忆画像，用治理规则管住AI记忆，让它记住对的、忘掉错的。

description.en: 把一本小说变成能读、能点、能探索的离线世界｜阅读器、世界地图、人物关系、成长曲线，一条命令出成品。
description.zh: 一条命令把小说变成能读能点的离线世界，地图、人物关系、成长曲线全都有。

description.en: 截屏、录屏、远控时让敏感窗口自动变黑，本机照常使用｜Windows 一键隐私防护，零遮挡、零删除。
description.zh: 截屏、录屏、远控时敏感窗口自动变黑，本机照常使用，Windows 一键隐私防护。

description.en: 把视频图片送进那些找不到文件夹的安卓 App，也能原样掏出来｜ADB + 界面自动化。
description.zh: 用 ADB 加界面自动化，把视频图片直接送进找不到文件夹的安卓 App，也能原样取回。

description.en: 把源码变成别人能双击打开的程序｜自动处理镜像、长路径、缓存与产物校验。
description.zh: 一条命令把 Electron/Node 源码打成别人双击就能用的程序，镜像、长路径、缓存和产物校验全帮你搞定。

description.en: Agent 干完活自动响一声｜12 秒原创提示音，Windows 零依赖，可换自己的音频。
description.zh: Agent 干完活自动响一声，12 秒原创提示音，Windows 零依赖，还能换成自己的音频。

description.en: trace based agent memory system
description.zh: 给编程 Agent 加一层执行轨迹记忆，自动记录并复用历史操作，跨项目跨会话都能记住。
发消息前在输入框提示当前是高峰还是低谷时段，让你一眼知道这条按什么价计费。

description.en: Project spaces, group chats, task boards, memory and usage for teams of DSH bots
description.zh: 把一群 DSH 机器人组建成团队，用项目群聊、任务板和共享记忆一起协作干活。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上「删除会话」：侧栏菜单一键删除，递归清理子会话、日志、投影缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 补上删除会话功能，一键连子会话、日志和缓存一起清干净。

description.en: Delegate subtasks from DeepSeek Harness to Herdr-managed coding agents, harvest exact results, and review them in DSH.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的子任务派给 Herdr 管理的编码代理，拿回准确结果并在 DSH 里直接审阅。

description.en: Run DeepSeek Harness from anywhere: one plugin suite with SSH ops, the Git workbench, browser automation and remote access from desktop and mobile.
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 DSH 远程操作：SSH 运维、Git 工作台、浏览器自动化，电脑手机都能用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) bundle that registers the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server as mcp__rea__* tools — third-party adapter
description.zh: 把 REA 逆向工程 MCP 服务器接进 DSH，让你直接调用工具拆解分析任意目标。

description.en: Host-side orchestrator for DSH agent teams. Every turn it injects an 11-section orchestration methodology into the system prompt and backs it with a counting tool-layer gate, so parallel dispatch, task-board tracking, cross-session handoff, employee-pool reuse and preset routing become the default in any preset and any session instead of something you have to ask for. The gate counts real dispatches (subagent / subagent_fork / spawn_teammate) rather than words: a todo listing N unmarked items only needs the base threshold, items explicitly marked as parallel must be launched in one batch up to a configurable cap, and a genuine single-step task is exempt by writing one marker. Read-only tools (read, glob, grep, context-management tools) are never gated. Team members are woken up and reused before new ones are hired, and subagents are reserved for work that must run under a specific preset. Local-only settings (preset routes, domain keywords, profile name, active tier) live in <DSH_HOME>/team-orchestrator.local.json and never ship inside the package. Status is exposed on a loopback-only HTTP route. Zero telemetry, no hosted service, no account. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: DSH 智能体团队的宿主端编排器。每轮把 11 节编排方法论注入系统提示，并配一层按真实派活次数计数的工具层硬门，让并行派活、任务板追踪、跨会话交接、员工池复用与预设路由在任何预设、任何会话里都是默认行为，而不是每次都要你特意要求。硬门只数真的派出去了几次（subagent / subagent_fork / spawn_teammate），不看你嘴上怎么说：todo 里列 N 条但没有并行标记时只要求基础门槛，明确标了并行的条目必须在同一批里一次派满（上限可配），真·单步任务写一个标记即可免派。只读工具（read、glob、grep 及上下文管理类工具）永不被拦。先唤醒并复用已有团队成员，不够才新增，subagent 只留给必须在某个专用预设下执行的任务。本机专属配置（预设路由表、业务域关键词、profile 名、当前挡位）外置在 <DSH_HOME>/team-orchestrator.local.json，从不随包发布。状态只在本机回环 HTTP 路由上暴露。零遥测、无托管服务、无需账号。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Multi-workspace agent federation with persistent ticket trees, parallel worker sessions, structured evidence reports, independent acceptance checks, retry/stop and restart recovery. Workers get shell and file tools in the ticket's directory, company_verify re-runs the ticket's acceptance commands in a shell on the host, and scope lists are task authorization rather than a sandbox. State is stored in ~/.dsh/ai-company; the optional company_repo_* tools run separately installed aoci/codegraph commands on any path they are given.
description.zh: 多工作区 Agent 联邦：持久化 Ticket 树、并行 Worker 会话、结构化证据报告、独立验收、重试停止与重启恢复。Worker 在工单目录里拥有 shell 与文件工具，company_verify 会在宿主上用 shell 重新执行工单的验收命令；scope 白名单是任务授权语义，不是沙箱。状态存放在 ~/.dsh/ai-company；可选的 company_repo_* 工具会在给定的任意路径上运行另行安装的 aoci / codegraph 命令。

description.en: Arknights-style procedural opening film and silent looping chat backdrop for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: Canvas-drawn visuals, synthesized WebAudio sound, click-anywhere skip, cross-dissolve into the interface, live-adjustable opacity; zero dependencies and no media files. By default the film (about 12 seconds, with sound) plays on every page load; a setting turns it off.
description.zh: 明日方舟风格的程序化开屏短片 + 静音循环聊天背景：Canvas 实时绘制、WebAudio 合成音效、点击画面跳过、片尾交叉溶解进界面、透明度实时可调；零依赖、无媒体文件。默认每次加载页面都会播放开屏短片（约 12 秒，带声音），可在设置里关闭。

description.en: Code review center for DSH, built on open-code-review: reviews current changes, commits, branch ranges, project architecture, code modules and business data flows, with live progress, a GitHub-style commit heatmap, fixed markers, automatic fix verification, light/dark themes and one-click fix sessions. Requires git and the open-code-review CLI 1.13 or later (npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review); reviewed code is sent to the LLM configured for that CLI, or to the session model when the review is delegated to it, and reopening a report after a fix session re-runs the review to verify the fixes.
description.zh: DSH 代码评审中心：基于 open-code-review，支持当前改动、提交、分支对比、项目架构、代码模块与信息流业务工作流评审，提供实时进度、GitHub 风格提交热力图、已修复标识、自动修复校验、深浅色主题与一键修复会话。需要 git 和 open-code-review 命令行（1.13 及以上，npm i -g @alibaba-group/open-code-review）；被评审的代码会发给该命令行所配置的模型，委托给会话时则发给当前会话模型；开过修复会话的报告再次打开时会重跑一次评审来校验修复。

description.en: Manual session handoff: when you decide a session has run out of usable context, one click turns its event log into a compact handoff document (goal, done, next, project facts), creates a new session seeded with it and wakes it to continue; the new session can inherit the session-bus name as <name>-handoff. No threshold, no timer, no automatic trigger.
description.zh: 会话手动交接：当你判断上下文确实用不下去时，点一下就把源会话日志压成紧凑交接文档（目标 / 已完成 / 下一步 / 项目事实），据此新建会话并唤醒它继续干活，可继承会话总线注册名（<名>-handoff）。无阈值、无定时、不自动触发。

description.en: Three client-only fixes for the web UI: unfolds the session list past its 5-row fold, collapses long tool-call runs behind one toggle, and restores the mobile sidebar drawer above its own mask.
description.zh: 三个纯前端修复：把会话列表被折叠的 5 行展开、把长串工具调用收进一个开关、修好手机端侧边栏抽屉被自己的遮罩盖住。

description.en: Adds a "Delete session" item to the sidebar session menu that moves the session transcript directory to the Windows Recycle Bin, or to a plugin trash folder under ~/.dsh/plugin-data when that is unavailable (restorable either way), and deletes its spill files and projection cache in one request, detaching a live session first and cascading to its subagent sessions. A setting switches the confirmation step off so deleting takes one click; duplicate delete items registered by other plugins are collapsed so only one remains.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话菜单里加一条「删除会话」，一次请求就把会话记录目录移进 Windows 回收站（用不了时移进 ~/.dsh/plugin-data 下的插件回收站，两种都可还原），并删除其溢出文件和投影缓存，正在使用的会话会先被摘下来，子代理会话一并级联清理。设置里可以关掉「删除前再次确认」，关掉后点一下就删；其它插件注册的同名菜单项会被合并，只留一条。

description.en: Adds one tool, echo_judge, that scores 1-4 draft replies to an emotionally loaded message on three steps (perception, mental-state inference, response strategy), combines the steps with a cascade gate and step-level credit assignment, and names the weakest step to redo; scoring runs through ctx.llm of the running engine, so no API key is needed.
description.zh: 加一个工具 echo_judge：对 1–4 条回复候选按「感知／心智状态推理／支持策略」三步打分，用级联门控与步骤级信用分配合成总分，并指出最弱、该重做的那一步；打分走引擎自带的 ctx.llm，不需要 API key。

description.en: A reading room kept for the agent: through reading_* tools it reads a book from ~/.dsh/reading one chapter at a time, writes notes beside chapters and keeps its own writing there, and a panel shows its reading progress. It adds lines to the system prompt telling the agent the room is its own and optional. Not a to-do list.
description.zh: 给智能体用的书房：它通过 reading_* 工具一章一章读 ~/.dsh/reading 里的书，在章节旁写读后感，也把自己写的东西放在这里，面板显示它的阅读进度。插件会往系统提示里加几行，告诉智能体这间书房归它自己、读不读随它。不是待办清单。

description.en: Local jot-down notes for DSH: one Markdown file per note, stored under ~/dsh随手笔记 by default (portable home path, no drive-letter assumption). Redesigned card UI, trash bin (deletions restorable for 30 days), custom tag management with stable per-tag colors (create tags ahead of use, delete one everywhere), compact/comfortable density, adjustable font size and line width, flat quick-scan list, full-text search, Markdown preview, autosave, batch deletion, zero-dependency Office text extraction, and AI write-back from conversations. Heavily reworked from dsh-knowledge-lite; pick the old library via the in-app root picker to migrate.
description.zh: 随手笔记：本地 Markdown 笔记插件，默认存放在用户主目录 ~/dsh随手笔记（跨平台、无盘符依赖）。卡片式全新界面，回收站（删除 30 天内可恢复），自定义标签管理（可提前建标签、一处删除全局生效、同名标签固定配色），列表密度切换与字号/行宽调节，平铺速览列表，全文检索，Markdown 预览，自动保存，批量删除，Office 零依赖文本抽取，支持 AI 回写。由 dsh-knowledge-lite 深度改造而来；老用户可在状态栏「库位置」选回旧库自动迁移。

description.en: Keyboard navigation for the DSH Web GUI: hold Control for 1-9 conversation numbers in the sidebar, Control+Tab to cycle, Control+J to jump to any conversation from a panel that also lists collapsed and not-yet-rendered ones, double-tap Option for clickable hints, and Option+Enter to focus the composer.
description.zh: 键盘流 DSH 会话导航：按住 Control 在侧边栏显示 1-9 编号、Control+Tab 轮转、Control+J 从覆盖全部会话（含折叠分组与未渲染行）的面板跳转；双击 Option 为可点击控件显示字母提示，Option+Enter 聚焦输入框。

description.en: iOS-style appearance plugin: light, dark and auto modes, iOS system accent colours, night eye-care, OpenCode palettes and typography, and local background images with blur, transparency and rotation.
description.zh: iOS 风格外观插件：浅色/深色/自动模式、iOS 系统色强调色板、夜间护眼、OpenCode 调色板与字体排版、本地背景图（模糊、透明、轮换）。

description.en: Ranks models in a ten-slot ladder, routes each subagent by a 1-10 difficulty, and falls back a tier when one fails. Windows only; applies to sessions that opt in. Subagents can also launch local agent CLIs (Codex verified, nine others experimental), and a subagent granted full authority runs its CLI with --dangerously-skip-permissions, --yolo or --force. Run records go to .dsh-supa/ in the workspace.
description.zh: 把模型排成十档阶梯，按 1–10 的难度给子代理选档，失败自动降一档。仅支持 Windows，按会话选择启用。子代理还可以启动本机的 agent CLI（Codex 已验证，另有 9 个为实验性），被授予完全权限的子代理会给其 CLI 加 --dangerously-skip-permissions、--yolo 或 --force。运行记录写在工作区的 .dsh-supa/ 里。

description.en: Lets DSH act as a Locus client and drive the Unity editor through the Locus native broker: 10 unity_* tools cover connection and editor status, C# evaluation on the editor main thread, Play/Edit mode switching, console log reading, compilation with domain reload, revision-guarded asset editing, and scene object search and property edits, Unity Test Framework runs, asset reference graphs, and Game/Scene view captures. Requires the Locus Unity package (com.farlocus.locus) with its native bridge enabled.
description.zh: 让 DSH 扮演 Locus 客户端，通过 Locus 原生 broker 操作 Unity 编辑器：10 个 unity_* 工具覆盖连接与编辑器状态、在主线程执行 C#、Play/Edit 模式切换、读取 Console、编译并等待域重载、带 revision 守卫的资产编辑，以及场景对象检索与属性修改、Unity Test Framework 测试运行、资产引用图和 Game/Scene 视图截图。需要先在 Unity 里装好 Locus 包（com.farlocus.locus）并开启其 NativeBridge。

description.en: Adds a Stars order to the plugin Discover tab, ranking entries by GitHub star counts taken from the market index site public catalog. Ships a star snapshot so the order works offline from the first launch, then refreshes it daily in the background. The daily refresh downloads the roughly 6 MB catalog.json from awesome-dsh-plugin.com, and the plugin wraps the host's global fetch to add the star sort key to the market index responses.
description.zh: 在「插件 → 发现」的排序菜单里增加「Star 数」，按市场索引站点公开目录中的 GitHub Star 数从高到低排序。随包带一份星标快照，首次启动即可离线排序，之后每天在后台刷新。每天的刷新会从 awesome-dsh-plugin.com 下载约 6 MB 的 catalog.json，插件还会包装宿主的全局 fetch，给市场索引的响应补上 Star 排序键。

description.en: Adds a quick-select model list to the DSH composer model button: a settings icon on the Model row of the model menu opens a dialog to pick and reorder favourite models, dragging vertically on the model button switches between them on release, and dragging left or right steps the reasoning effort; the menu's reasoning-effort row also gets a draggable slider (based on Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider). Text follows the DSH language setting (English / Chinese).
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框的模型按钮加入快速选择列表：模型菜单 Model 行右端的设置图标打开弹窗，勾选并排序常用模型；在模型按钮上竖向拖动、松手即在这些模型间切换，左右拖动逐档调整推理等级；菜单的「推理等级」行同时变成可拖动的滑条（基于 Microqian2th/dsh-codex-effort-slider）。界面文字跟随 DSH 语言设置（中文 / English）。

description.en: Native Google Antigravity agents loader and subagent orchestration engine with model selection and Web UI settings integration. Loads agent definitions from ~/.agents/agents and the workspace's .agents/agents; the selected main agent's instructions go into the system prompt, and a matching agent's instructions are prepended to DSH's own subagent and spawn_teammate calls. Settings are written to .agents/agents/settings.json in the workspace.
description.zh: 原生 Google Antigravity Agent 规范加载与子代理编排引擎，支持模型选择与 Web 设置界面集成。从 ~/.agents/agents 和工作区的 .agents/agents 读取 agent 定义；选中的主 agent 的指令会写进系统提示，匹配到的 agent 指令还会加到 DSH 自带的 subagent / spawn_teammate 调用的提示词前面；设置写在工作区的 .agents/agents/settings.json。

description.en: Loads Google Antigravity rules from ~/.agents/rules and the workspace's .agents/rules into the system prompt: always-on rules in full, the rest as a catalog the model can load with the antigravity_rule tool, or that activates when a touched file matches a rule's globs. The rules are prompt guidance rather than hard enforcement, and the model can toggle them off with the same tool. Settings are written to .agents/rules/settings.json in the workspace.
description.zh: 把 ~/.agents/rules 和工作区 .agents/rules 里的 Google Antigravity 规则加进系统提示：always_on 规则全文注入，其余以目录形式列出，模型可用 antigravity_rule 工具加载，或在触及的文件匹配规则 glob 时自动激活。规则只是提示词层面的指引，不是强制执行，模型也能用同一个工具把它们关掉。设置写在工作区的 .agents/rules/settings.json。

description.en: Native DSH support for context-mode (mksglu/context-mode), intercepting large tool outputs with SQLite FTS5 indexing, BM25+RRF search, and session continuity. On by default: tool outputs over 4 KB are replaced with a short preview while the full text is indexed into ~/.context-mode/context.db, and a section is added to the system prompt. Its ctx_execute and ctx_batch tools run shell, Node, Python, PowerShell or cmd commands with DSH's own permissions and environment (not sandboxed), and ctx_index reads any local file path or fetches any http(s) URL it is given.
description.zh: 原生支持 context-mode (mksglu/context-mode)，通过 SQLite FTS5 拦截工具大输出并提供 BM25+RRF 搜索与会话连续性恢复。默认开启：超过 4 KB 的工具输出会被替换成简短预览，全文索引进 ~/.context-mode/context.db，并在系统提示里加一段说明。其 ctx_execute、ctx_batch 工具以 DSH 自身的权限和环境变量运行 shell / Node / Python / PowerShell / cmd 命令（没有沙箱），ctx_index 可读取任意本地文件路径或抓取任意 http(s) 地址。

description.en: Adds a /grill-me slash command that switches the session to plan mode and prompts the agent to ask 3 to 20 structured questions about your goal, each with a recommended option and alternatives, through ask_user_question before it plans.
description.zh: 添加 /grill-me 斜杠命令：把会话切到计划模式，并提示 agent 在规划前通过 ask_user_question 就你的目标提出 3 到 20 个结构化问题，每个问题带推荐选项和备选项。

description.en: Add-on layer over the official QQ bot plugin @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot: gates group messages before they reach the agent (probability, debounce with backlog, invalid-message filtering, admin approval before reading attachments), greets idle private chats, and adds emoji stickers via dsh-meme, TTS/ASR voice replies, image generation and one settings page. Needs the official QQ bot plugin installed (plus dsh-meme for stickers). Group gating defaults to a 25% chance and only applies when mentions are not required; the private-chat greeting is on by default (22:00-08:00, at most 3 a night, only to chats that wrote first); voice and image generation call endpoints you configure; with no admins configured nobody can approve attachments.
description.zh: 官方 QQ 机器人插件 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 的拓展层：群聊消息进 agent 前先按概率、防抖加积压、无效消息过滤做频控收敛，非管理员附件需管理员回「同意」才读取，私聊按空闲时长主动问候，并补上表情包、TTS/ASR 语音条、绘图与统一设置页。需要先装好官方 QQ 机器人插件（表情包还需 dsh-meme）。群聊按概率放行默认为 25%，且只在不要求 @ 机器人时生效；私聊问候默认开启（22:00–08:00，每晚最多 3 次，只对先发过消息的会话）；语音和绘图调用你自己配置的接口；没配置管理员时没人能批准附件。

description.en: Read-only session dashboard for DeepSeek Harness over the local ~/.dsh data: a sidebar overview of every session (tokens, estimated cost, turns, tool calls, model mix, daily activity, searchable and sortable session table) and an in-conversation Dashboard view that shows the current conversation turn by turn with per-turn tokens, cost, timing and tools. Zero dependencies, no network.
description.zh: 会话仪表盘，只读本机 ~/.dsh：侧栏总览全部会话（Token、估算成本、轮次、工具调用、模型构成、每日活动、可搜索可排序的会话表），并在会话内提供「仪表盘」视图，逐轮展示当前对话的 Token、成本、耗时与工具。零依赖、不联网。

description.en: Export a DSH session tree (lead plus subagent fleet) to two Markdown files from one frozen snapshot: a readable narrative summary and a complete raw archive. Target directories are checked against the session file policy, and a blocked location falls back to the workspace exports folder.
description.zh: 把一次会话及其智能体编队从同一份冻结快照导出为两份 Markdown：可读叙事摘要与完整原始存档。导出位置按会话文件策略校验，不可写时自动改存工作区 exports 目录。

description.en: Session-archive layer for DSH. It injects one per-workspace Markdown file into the system prompt on every turn, searches past session transcripts with AND keywords, an optional time window and a workspace filter, and recovers the images and documents those past sessions carried by returning their original local paths or copying them to a chosen directory. It also reports index health: version, entry count, cache usage, frequent sessions and sessions stored in an archive format it does not recognise. Keyword search only, no embedding service.
description.zh: DSH 的会话档案层。每轮把一个按工作区定位的 Markdown 记忆文件注入系统提示；跨历史会话检索 对话原文，支持多关键词 AND、时间窗与工作区过滤；还能取出历史会话携带的图片和文档，给出原始 本地路径或批量复制到指定目录。另外提供体检：索引版本、条目数、缓存占用、高频会话，以及未知 归档格式的告警。仅关键词检索，不依赖向量服务。

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: browse and search DSH skills, import from a folder or GitHub, and read full SKILL.md bodies rendered as Markdown. Imports are copied into ~/.dsh/skills (existing names are overwritten only on opt-in), skills there can be moved to a .trash folder from the detail view, and GitHub imports download the repository archive from codeload.github.com. It uses the same package name (dsh-skill-hub) and mount id (skill-hub) as cheshireez/dsh-skill-hub and hoshino114/dsh-skill-hub, so only one of the three can be installed.
description.zh: 侧栏技能中心：浏览、搜索 DSH 技能，从文件夹或 GitHub 导入技能，并以 Markdown 渲染查看完整技能正文。导入的技能复制到 ~/.dsh/skills（同名只在勾选覆盖时才覆盖），详情页可把其中的技能移入 .trash 回收目录；GitHub 导入会从 codeload.github.com 下载仓库压缩包。包名 dsh-skill-hub 和挂载 id skill-hub 与 cheshireez/dsh-skill-hub、hoshino114/dsh-skill-hub 相同，三者只能装一个。

description.en: Connects the Solmirror open platform to DeepSeek Harness as MCP tools covering image and video generation, a model catalog, cost estimates, reference uploads, result queries and media URLs. Generation jobs submit as native dsh background tasks that notify on completion and run in parallel within one message, with in-chat video playback and an image wall. A settings page takes the platform API key, server URL, per-group model visibility and a test-connection check; the key is stored in the local dsh credential store. Reference uploads (image, video, audio) return reusable ids kept one day unused or three days after last use — 50 MB per file, video up to 30 s, audio up to 60 s. Usage bills platform points at in-site prices, with quotes before a run and automatic refunds on failure. Files passed to upload_reference (jpg/png/webp/gif, mp4/mov/webm, mp3/wav, up to 50 MB) leave your machine: images and videos go straight to Volcengine ImageX/VOD storage with temporary credentials issued by Solmirror, audio through the Solmirror server; its HTTP routes (/plugins/solmirror/...) have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 把瞬镜开放平台的图片、视频生成能力接入 DeepSeek Harness：MCP 工具覆盖模型目录、估价、参考素材上传、文生图/图生图、文生视频/图生视频、结果查询与媒体地址。生成提交为 dsh 原生后台任务，完成自动通知，同一消息内并行执行；对话内视频播放、图片出图墙。设置页配置平台 API 密钥、服务器地址、可见模型组与测试连接，密钥只存本机凭据存储。参考素材（图片/视频/音频）上传一次可复用，未用保留 1 天、用过自最后使用保留 3 天（单文件 ≤50MB，视频 ≤30 秒，音频 ≤60 秒）；按平台价格计积分，生成前可询价，失败自动退款。传给 upload_reference 的文件（jpg/png/webp/gif、mp4/mov/webm、mp3/wav，≤50 MB）会离开本机：图片和视频用瞬镜签发的临时凭证直传火山引擎 ImageX/VOD 存储，音频经瞬镜服务器中转；插件的 HTTP 路由（/plugins/solmirror/…）没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Session tabs for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI whose open-session set is shared across every device attached to the same host, with workspace grouping, status dots, and a bottom bar that collapses into a drawer on narrow screens.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的会话标签栏：同一宿主下的所有设备共享一份「打开过的会话」集合，带 workspace 分组、状态点，窄屏时横条贴底并收进抽屉。

description.en: Adds a live system dashboard with per-core CPU, memory, GPU, processes, disk usage and a STOP action for ending processes, plus per-process energy on macOS, exposed as a browser page, a GUI panel and a `systemInfo` service other plugins can inject. macOS is the main platform and Linux is best-effort. The dashboard page and its read-only JSON (process list with users, disks, logged-in users) are served with no login check; publicDashboard: false only refuses non-loopback peers. STOP accepts loopback requests only and sends SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after a grace period, to any process your account may signal except pid 1, the DSH host and its parent.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中提供 CPU（逐核）、内存、GPU、进程、磁盘占用与 STOP 结束进程的实时仪表盘，macOS 上另含逐进程能耗，并提供浏览器页面、侧栏面板与供其他插件注入的 systemInfo 服务。以 macOS 为主，Linux 尽力支持。仪表盘页面及其只读 JSON（含进程列表与所属用户、磁盘、已登录用户）不做登录校验，publicDashboard 设为 false 也只是拒绝非回环来源。STOP 只接受回环请求，会对你的账号有权发信号的任何进程先发 SIGTERM、宽限期后再发 SIGKILL，pid 1、DSH 宿主进程及其父进程除外。

description.en: Dispatch a task to a real DSH session by workspace path or session id; results land in a persistent task ledger that can be queried without triggering the model. It serves HTTP on 127.0.0.1:7391 and requires a bearer token it generates on first run (kept in ~/.dsh/relay/token), rejects non-loopback Host and foreign Origin, and stores task results as JSON files under ~/.dsh/relay/tasks; an optional notifyUrl receives each finished result.
description.zh: 按工作空间或会话 id 给真实的 DSH 会话派发任务；结果写入持久任务台账，查询时不会触发模型。它在 127.0.0.1:7391 提供 HTTP 接口，首次运行自动生成令牌并要求 Bearer 认证（存放在 ~/.dsh/relay/token），拒绝非回环 Host 与外部 Origin；任务结果以 JSON 文件存在 ~/.dsh/relay/tasks，可选的 notifyUrl 会收到每个完成任务的结果。

description.en: The row that is running expands itself and folds back when it settles. A running turn keeps its whole procedure in one height-capped window that scrolls itself; a finished turn merges into the built-in finished header, leaving only the final answer. It works by driving the official disclosure rows rather than drawing its own panel, leaves rows you opened by hand alone, and restores the official settings on uninstall.
description.zh: 正在跑的那一行自动展开、跑完自动收起；跑着的一轮把过程收进一个限高窗口，页面不再被越堆越长的步骤拽着走；一轮结束并进官方那条「已完成」表头，只留最终回复。做法是点官方自己的折叠行、给官方过程体加限高，不自绘面板；你手动开合过的行不动，卸载时把改过的官方设置还原。

description.en: Open and edit Visio (.vsdx) drawings in a DSH panel: live SVG preview, shape and connector editing, layout checks, and a visio tool so the agent can read and modify the drawing. A pure-Python engine, so Visio and Office are not required. Edits are saved in place with a bounded .bak history. Needs Python 3.9+ on PATH (or the pythonPath setting); PNG export and snapshots also need Pillow.
description.zh: 在 DSH 面板里打开和编辑 Visio（.vsdx）图纸：实时 SVG 预览、图形与连接线编辑、布局检查，另有一个让 Agent 直接读写图纸的 visio 工具。引擎是纯 Python，不需要装 Visio 或 Office。编辑直接写回原文件，并保留有限的 .bak 历史。需要 PATH 里有 Python 3.9+（或在插件设置里填 pythonPath）；导出 PNG 和快照另需 Pillow。

description.en: Zotero bridge: search, read, add, update and trash items in a local Zotero library, read PDF annotations and notes, pull indexed full text, and find related papers by DOI. Needs Zotero 7 or later with its local API enabled; the first write triggers a Zotero authorization prompt (the key is stored in plugin-data/dsh-zotero/auth.json) and permanent deletion asks for confirmation. Finding and adding items query OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv, PubMed and Open Library. Uses the same package name (dsh-zotero) as Vncntvx/dsh-zotero, so only one of the two can be installed per profile.
description.zh: Zotero 直连：检索、新增、修改、回收本机条目，读 PDF 高亮批注与笔记，取已索引全文，按 DOI 找相关论文。需要 Zotero 7 及以上并开启其本地 API；首次写入会触发 Zotero 授权提示（密钥存在 plugin-data/dsh-zotero/auth.json），永久删除需要确认。检索与新增文献会查询 OpenAlex、Crossref、arXiv、PubMed 和 Open Library。包名与 Vncntvx/dsh-zotero 相同（dsh-zotero），同一个 profile 里只能装其中一个。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中与 AI 或桌宠伙伴玩游戏，内置 21 点和双人吹牛骰。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里和 AI 或桌宠伙伴面对面玩 21 点和双人吹牛骰，还能聊天看战绩。

description.en: OpenScience research plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 370 research skills, 6 literature tools and an always-on research loop - in every session, no preset needed.
description.zh: 装一次就能在每个会话里做科研：370 个科研技能、6 个文献工具加常驻研究循环，开箱即用。

description.en: Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: auto capture, tiered hybrid recall (vector + FTS5), zero dependencies, Node only.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加长期记忆，自动记录对话，向量加全文混合检索，纯 Node 零依赖。

description.en: A股投研插件：明确的行业偏好、原文互核、风险约束与计划；Cindy 与 DeepSeek Harness 适配，无自动交易
description.zh: 帮你圈定A股行业范围、留存原文证据、给出带风险约束的配置建议和复查计划，只做研究不自动交易。

description.en: Bookmark a passage or a whole message in a conversation and jump back to it with one click.
description.zh: 在对话里划选一段话或整条消息打书签，之后一键跳回原位。

description.en: Video and audio file viewers for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, including the dsh-better-sidebar file tree, with byte-range seeking.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏直接播放视频和音频，支持文件树浏览与按字节范围拖动进度。

description.en: A startup command panel for DeepSeek Harness: which project to pick up, machine health, backups and fleet status.
description.zh: 启动即打开的命令中心面板，一眼看清该接哪个项目、机器状态、备份和集群情况。

description.en: Seven Gruvbox themes for DeepSeek Harness with a preview picker, persisted selection, and system light/dark following.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换上七款 Gruvbox 配色主题，支持预览选择、记住设置并跟随系统深浅色。

description.en: Zero-dependency memory core for DeepSeek Harness: pointer/core preloading, BM25/hybrid retrieval, auditable consolidation, cloud tiering. Plain Markdown canon, rebuildable index.
description.zh: 给 AI 智能体加一套零依赖记忆系统，能预加载、检索、整理长期记忆，还能分层上云。

description.en: Companion plugin for DS Bot on DeepSeek Harness: pick a DSH mode (agent preset) per Bot
description.zh: 给每个 DS Bot 单独选 DSH 模式，让不同机器人按需切换预设，灵活又省心。

description.en: DS-link — local session collaboration and bubble/card chat views for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让 DSH 里已有的会话互相协作，还能用气泡卡片方式聊天，本地就能用。

description.en: Desktop toasts and an approval ledger for DeepSeek Harness: clicking a toast restores DSH and jumps to the session, every approval is recorded, and a session can remember your decisions.
description.zh: 审批弹桌面通知，点一下就能跳回对应会话，所有审批都记进台账，还能记住你的选择。

description.en: Multi-source academic literature search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (Web of Science / CNKI / arXiv / Crossref), with a pluggable source registry and a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 Web of Science、知网、arXiv、Crossref 多源学术文献检索，侧边栏直接看结果。

description.en: Offline A-share valuation-percentile and financial-statement checkups for DeepSeek Harness. Bring your own data; never fetches quotes.
description.zh: 自带数据离线做 A 股估值分位和财务体检，不联网抓行情，四个工具直接调用。

description.en: Show the DeepSeek account credit as plain text in the DSH composer status row.
description.zh: 在输入框下方状态栏用纯文本显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，随时看清还剩多少额度。

description.en: Connect a locally installed agy CLI to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1, with separate thinking levels, quota display, and Harness-owned tools. Community fork of dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp, beta, verified on Windows x64 only. Needs the agy CLI signed in with your own Google account; installing makes new chats default to Agy models (messages go through agy to Google), switches web search to the agy provider and replaces the built-in compaction. Do not enable it alongside other forks that register the agy-local-acp provider.
description.zh: 将本机 agy CLI 接入 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1，提供独立思考档位、额度显示和由 Harness 执行的工具调用。dannndouglas/dsh-antigravity-acp 的社区分支，测试版，仅在 Windows x64 上验证。需要本机 agy CLI 并用你自己的 Google 账号登录；安装后新对话默认走 Agy 模型（消息经 agy 发往 Google），网页搜索切到 agy 提供方，并替换内置的上下文压缩。不要与其他注册 agy-local-acp 提供方的分支同时启用。

description.en: AI 速成视频（DSH 插件）——341 种风格提示词，一句话生成视频：每个场景对应一个 Canvas 页面，逐帧渲染，TTS + BGM + SFX。
description.zh: 一句话就能生成短视频，341 种风格任选，自动配音配乐加音效，长片也能自拟。

description.en: Algorithm coach (算法教练) — a DeepSeek Harness plugin for practising LeetCode: mental models, layered SVG step animations, a CodeMirror editor with click-to-learn API docs, local TypeScript/Go judging, and manual submission.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里刷 LeetCode：看思维模型和分步动画，用编辑器边写边查 API，本地判题。

description.en: Translates Chinese text across the DeepSeek Harness interface into English - plugin pages, settings, dropdowns, view tabs and iframe panels.
description.zh: 把 DSH 界面里的中文统统翻成英文，插件页、设置、菜单、标签页和 iframe 面板都覆盖。
给工具审批卡片加上可追问的中文说明，点批准前先看清到底在要什么权限。

description.en: DSH conversation archive toolkit: session cascade delete, message tombstone delete, fork from message, whole-message quote
description.zh: 给 DSH 补上删会话、删消息、按消息分叉和整条消息引用，历史日志不动。

description.en: A-share assistant: 19 tools for quotes, K-line, screening, sentiment and backtests, plus a manual trade ledger, a sidebar panel, daily archive snapshots and risk-alert email. No broker connection or order placement.
description.zh: A 股助手：19 个行情/选股/舆情/回测工具，外加手工交易台账、右栏面板、每日存档与高风险邮件提醒；不接券商、不下单。

description.en: Bilibili live danmaku as an always-visible overlay in the DSH Web UI.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页界面里悬浮显示 B 站直播间弹幕，切换页面也不消失，边干活边看直播。

description.en: Bots for DeepSeek Harness: named AI teammates with persona, workspace, optional Docker VM, scheduling and desktop reminders
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一群有名字、有人设的 AI 队友，能分派任务、定时提醒，还能跑在独立工作区或 Docker 里。

description.en: DSH 分支管理插件：输入框分支芯片、未保存/未推送状态、切换与快捷操作
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示当前分支，随时查看未保存/未推送状态并一键切换分支。

description.en: A real Chromium in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar: the agent drives it, and you can take over to sign in.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧栏里跑一个真 Chromium，AI 自动操作网页，遇到登录、验证码时你随时接手。

description.en: DSH 插件：把 Chrome/Edge 登录 Cookie 通过本机 CDP 调试桥注入 DSH 内置浏览器（右侧栏 Browser 标签），免重复登录
description.zh: 把 Chrome/Edge 的登录 Cookie 同步进 DSH 内置浏览器，免去重复登录，也不会把原会话挤下线。

description.en: Runs macOS caffeinate bound to the DSH host process with -w and exposes /keepawake to report and switch sleep-prevention modes.
description.zh: DSH 运行期间自动阻止 Mac 休眠，还能用 /keepawake 查看和切换防睡眠模式。

description.en: Render any Markdown report or DSH session excerpt into shareable PNG images with no npm dependencies, driving the Chromium-family browser already on the machine and falling back to PDF, then HTML. Reports come out as a summary card plus a full verbatim long image; a report written for dsh-fact-check also gets the tier badge, the two rails and the per-claim tiering, all taken from the report itself, and a report following one of the other report skeletons it defines gets the section that skeleton designates as its conclusion lifted onto the summary card. Conversations come out as a message flow, exportable by turn range, event range or the most recent N turns.
description.zh: 把任意 Markdown 报告或 DSH 会话片段渲染成可分享的 PNG 图片，零 npm 依赖：复用本机已有的 Chromium 系浏览器，不可用时退回 PDF、再退回 HTML。报告输出短图（结论）加长图（完整原文）；dsh-fact-check 的报告额外带档位徽标、甲乙双轨与逐条断言分档（都取自报告本身），其余几种报告骨架则把该骨架自己指定的结论段抬到短图上。对话输出消息流长图，可按轮次、事件序号或最近 N 轮选定范围。

description.en: DSH theme, has three palettes (Nord, Solarized, One Dark), per-mode customization (accent, background, foreground, translucent sidebar, contrast, wallpaper), an optional card layout for shell columns, and conversation content width.
description.zh: 给 DSH 网页界面换主题，内置 Nord、Solarized、One Dark 三套配色，还能按模式调色和开卡片布局。
给 DSH Agent 装上一个傲娇黏人的幼鲸娘人格，说话简体中文，聪明又爱偷懒。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for team chat and persistent AI mission threads. Mention @deepseek to run an agent with channel memory and native TODOs.
description.zh: 在团队聊天里 @deepseek 就能让 AI 带着频道记忆和待办跑任务，适合多人协作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness chat upgrade: in-session reply versions, message editing, rollback, soft deletion, and a recycle bin. / DSH 对话增强：同会话回复多版本、编辑、回退、软删除与回收站。
description.zh: 给 DSH 对话加上回复多版本、编辑、回退、软删除和回收站，改错删错都能找回。

description.en: A DSH plugin.
description.zh: 把一段中文聊天记录变成一条能直接发出去的回复，判断情绪、选策略、带梗还说明理由。

description.en: Mark key or excluded chat passages, then turn the conversation into a checked Markdown article for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在聊天里标出重点、排除废话，一键把对话整理成校对过的 Markdown 文章。

description.en: Image wallpaper behind the DSH chat UI with frosted composer and bubbles, automatic blur when a conversation has content, and a frosted backdrop behind settings-style overlays.
description.zh: 给 DSH 聊天界面换上一张背景图，输入框和气泡都变成磨砂玻璃质感，有对话时自动模糊，好看又不挡内容。

description.en: Puts one editable line at the very front of every DeepSeek Harness system prompt, so the model thinks in Chinese.
description.zh: 在每个系统提示词最前面加一行「请全程使用中文思考」，让模型用中文推理，主会话和子代理都生效。

description.en: codex 同款 dsh chrome 操作：@ 提及真实 Chrome 标签页，用可信输入点击、输入、拖拽
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接读取并操作你正在用的 Chrome 标签页，点击输入拖拽都像真人操作。

description.en: 起居注：把 DeepSeek Harness 里的对话收口成可审、可检索、可关联的 Markdown 编年史 + 事实库。零第三方依赖。
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的对话整理成可查可审的 Markdown 编年史和事实库，零依赖。

description.en: claude_delegate: one DeepSeek Harness tool that delegates to the host Claude Code CLI with per-call model and effort (no pinned SDK).
description.zh: 一个工具把任务转交给 Claude Code CLI 执行，每次调用都能单独指定模型和强度。

description.en: Tongzhou: named local Codex–DSH discussions and read-only conversation views, with a DSH bundle and optional one-click Codex skill setup. Initially supports macOS with DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1.
description.zh: 同舟：Codex 与 DSH 的本机具名讨论和只读会话阅读，提供 DSH 插件与可选的一键 Codex 技能接入。首版支持 macOS 和 DSH Desktop 0.2.2-rc.1。

description.en: Codex-style composer model picker: a card showing the current model and a draggable slider that sets reasoning effort, with one stop per level the model advertises and an Off stop when the provider supports it. The slider snaps only to whole stops and updates the effort label while dragging; selecting a model or effort still goes through the session model directory, so it stays in sync with the rest of the composer.
description.zh: Codex 风格的输入框模型选择器：卡片显示当前模型，底部用可拖动的滑杆设置推理强度，每个档位都对应模型真实声明的推理等级（提供商支持时有 Off 档）。滑杆只停在整档上，拖动过程中推理强度文字即时更新；模型与档位的切换仍走会话的模型目录，与输入框其他部分保持同步。

description.en: Codex subscription usage card pinned at the DSH sidebar foot, plus a quota dashboard. Reads the ChatGPT quota that the dsh-codex-subscription plugin reports.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部固定一张 Codex 额度卡片，点开就能看完整配额仪表盘，用量一目了然。

description.en: Abort a collapsing LLM stream: trip on repeated short lines and end the step as a provider failure so the garbage never reaches the model's visible history.
description.zh: 模型输出开始刷屏重复短句时自动掐断流，把垃圾内容挡在对话历史外。

description.en: 上下文压缩的时机管理：水位提醒 + 主动压缩，两个开关可独立关闭。配套 SKILL.md 提供通用的压缩时机判据。
description.zh: 给上下文压缩加个时机提醒，快满时催模型先整理重点，还能主动压缩，两个开关随便关。

description.en: Cache-friendly context compaction for DeepSeek Harness, with requirement retention, task continuity, history retrieval, and retries.
description.zh: 长对话自动压缩上下文，保留需求和进度，让任务接着往下做不跑偏。
把 DSH 左侧栏改成 Codex 风格紧凑布局，置顶、工作区和插件入口分层收纳，界面更清爽。

description.en: A community bundle for DeepSeek Harness that makes it a vibe-coding workspace: one calm theme, nine build-loop skills, a small MCP pack.
description.zh: 一个让 DeepSeek Harness 变成顺手氛围编程工作区的社区插件包，含主题、九项构建技能和 MCP 小包。

description.en: 输入框按钮管家：DSH 输入框工具栏的显隐总开关。一个「⋯」按钮列出所有插件挂上去的控件，逐项勾选即可隐藏或显示，状态自动持久化；按钮本身还能挂到 9 个位置任选（工具栏 / 输入框两侧 / 会话头 / 侧栏底部 / 右下悬浮球），工具栏整行被挤掉时也照样能打开。只隐藏不卸载，随时可一键全部恢复。
description.zh: 给输入框工具栏装个总开关，不用的按钮一键收起，想用时随时全部放回来。
把模型选择和推理强度滑块挪到输入框里，切换模型和推理等级不用再翻菜单了。

description.en: One-shot notes in the DeepSeek Harness composer: insert a saved note into the message input, then delete it.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加个笔记按钮，一键把保存的笔记插进消息里，发完自动删掉。

description.en: 基于 988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-computer-use (MIT)的插件社区修复分支：独立虚拟光标、Chromium CDP 通道、常驻 MCP 引擎通道、元素优先点击，13 个工具。
description.zh: 修复版电脑操控插件，独立虚拟光标加元素优先点击，让 AI 更稳地操作桌面和浏览器。

description.en: 把华为云果办 OfficeAce 接进 DeepSeek Harness：有客户端自动读登录态，没有就浏览器登录；多账号进池，可勾选、可切换、失败自动换号。
description.zh: 把华为云果办 OfficeAce 接进 DSH，自动读登录态或浏览器登录，多账号进池可切换、失败自动换号。

description.en: DSH plugin: WPS Lingxi as a model provider — native tools/reasoning passthrough, credits, check-in, zero-paste login
description.zh: 把 WPS 灵犀接进 DSH 当模型源，11 个模型和原生工具、推理直通，还能看智点余额和签到。

description.en: 把秒悟 Meoo 的模型接进 DSH：API Key 一键登录、积分余额、模型目录对齐官网
description.zh: 把秒悟 Meoo 的模型接进 DSH，一键登录就能像原生 provider 一样切换使用。

description.en: Connects the models of the SCNet (超算互联网) Computing Service desktop client to DSH, adding a per-model switches tab on the plugin page and adapting the transcript to whichever pi-ai generation the profile resolves. Reuses the API key the SCNet client cached under ~/.sclaw (or SCNET_API_KEY, or a key set in the plugin config) and sends chats to api.scnet.cn through a loopback proxy; it depends on SCNet's unofficial client interface, which may change, and use is subject to SCNet's terms.
description.zh: 把本机 SCNet（超算互联网）计算服务客户端已登录的模型接入 DSH，插件页提供逐模型开关标签页，并按 profile 实际解析到的 pi-ai 世代自动适配 transcript 形状。沿用 SCNet 客户端缓存在 ~/.sclaw 下的 API Key（也可用 SCNET_API_KEY 或插件配置里填的 Key），经本机回环代理把对话发往 api.scnet.cn；依赖 SCNet 客户端的非官方接口，上游调整后可能失效，使用受 SCNet 服务条款约束。
